title: Interview prep
sub: Likely questions, model answers grounded in your real experience, and feedback on your practice.

mock.title: Mock interview
mock.intro: A live back-and-forth: the interviewer asks about your real experience, probes vague answers, and scores the whole session at the end. Nothing is saved on the server.
mock.jdOptional: Pasting the job description is optional — with one, the interviewer asks role-specific questions.
mock.placeholder: Type your answer… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
mock.doneNote: The interviewer has finished — end the session to get your scorecard.

recruiter.salaryCaveat: Guidance on framing — not a number to quote. Research the market range for the role and location.
